Shall_Statement: The Contractor shall provide a baseline network architecture for the QPLANT Control System and a System Interlock Diagram.
The Contractor shall provide a baseline software architecture for the QPLANT Control System and update it to final status at Detailed Design.
The Contractor shall deliver a Network Ports and Protocols List.
The Contractor shall deliver Final IP Address Allocation Documentation.
The Contractor shall deliver Remote Upgrade Procedure Tools Documentation.
The Contractor shall deliver Backup and Restore Process Documentation.
The Contractor shall deliver a Device Identification and MAC Address List.
The Contractor shall deliver the DHCP Configuration Procedure Documentation.
The Contractor shall document the system's security features and demonstrate alignment with the Client's standards.
The Contractor shall deliver a Log Format Specification Documentation.
